subject: Final Notice: Mosaic Health outstanding balance & tax allocation
messages:
From: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@mosaichealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:14:00Z
Subject: Outstanding invoice INV2026-1188 — proposed partial payment

Hi Logan / Marcus,

Apologies for the late note — we've had an internal delay on Mosaic's treasury side. We received the final approval to pay but can only remit a partial settlement this month.

We can send $85,000 (of $150,000) on 2026-11-10 and the remainder on 2026-11-30, provided Redwood confirms you will not send the account to collections in the interim. Can you also reattach the original invoice and confirm the VAT breakdown (we need the tax line for our AP team).

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Brown
Director, Finance Operations
Mosaic Health
Attachment: INV2026-1188.pdf (pdf, original invoice)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV2026-1188 — proposed partial payment

Hi Olivia — thanks for the update. We can accept the partial payment on 2026-11-10 with the balance due 2026-11-30 on the conditions below: 

- Redwood will post a temporary hold on collections until 2026-11-30 contingent on receiving $85,000 on 2026-11-10.
- Please provide a remittance confirmation for the 11/10 payment and the VAT evidence (tax invoice or reverse-charge confirmation) so our billing team can clear the ledger.
- If the second payment is not received by 2026-11-30 we will escalate to the credit committee and may apply late fees per our T&Cs.

I've attached the invoice and included Marcus to coordinate the mutual action plan. If Mosaic needs a reissued invoice for tax reasons let us know precisely what wording or entity is required.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: INV2026-1188.pdf (pdf, re-sent)

From: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@mosaichealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV2026-1188 — proposed partial payment

Logan — quick update. Our bank flagged the transfer for a withholding tax (WHT) review. Treasury is asking for a revised invoice that separates the net amount and the VAT line and includes our EU entity name so they can process without additional WHT withholding.

We fully intend to send the $85,000 on 2026-11-10 but need your billing team to reissue the invoice to: Mosaic Health EU Ltd. and include the VAT line as follows: VAT 0% (reverse charge) — our AP requires that explicit language. If Redwood cannot reissue, treasury will hold payment pending a tax advisor note which could delay the 11/10 date.

Olivia

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:00:00Z
Subject: INTERNAL — payment plan acceptance & next steps

Team — ticking items after Olivia's note: 

1) Legal / Billing: we can reissue a new invoice to Mosaic Health EU Ltd with a reverse-charge VAT line but need confirmation on entity tax ID (Olivia's AP should provide).
2) Credit: recommend we accept the $85k partial on 11/10 and mark account "staged" — no collections activity if the remittance clears and AP sends VAT evidence by 11/15.
3) Escalation trigger: if final payment not received by 11/30 escalate to credit committee. I suggest we table late fees for now but reserve the right to apply them if we proceed to escalation.

I'm attaching a short mutual action plan we can share with Mosaic (dates, amounts, deliverables). If leadership needs to be looped (credit committee chair / CFO) we should be prepared to escalate on 12/01.

Marcus Lin
Director, Accounts Receivable
Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_Mosaic.docx (docx)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV2026-1188 — partial payment received / next steps

Olivia — thanks. Finance confirms we received the $85,000 ACH this morning (ref 11/12-Mosaic-Remit). We reissued the invoice to the EU entity per your request and uploaded the VAT reverse-charge wording to your AP Drive link (see HubSpot note below).

Next steps we agreed: 
- Mosaic to remit remaining $65,000 by 2026-11-30 (net amount as on reissued invoice).
- Mosaic AP to send remittance + VAT evidence (tax ID + reverse-charge confirmation) by 2026-11-15 so we can clear the interim payment in our ledger.
- If we do not receive the balance by 2026-11-30 we will escalate to the credit committee (planned review week of 2026-12-01) and may reapply late fees per contract.

We appreciate the coordinated approach — please confirm receipt of the reissued invoice and the Drive link so Marcus can close the loop on our side.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
